title: AusClinBench: a deterministically scored benchmark of large language models against current Australian clinical policy
abstract: arXiv:2610.31993v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI models already inform clinical decisions and draft notes in Australian clinical software, usually without the practitioner being told which model is used. Existing medical benchmarks are written for other jurisdictions. We wrote 142 questions from Australian guidelines and schedules across five domains (PBS authority, MBS billing, Ahpra obligations, triage red flags, immunisation and screening), each with one verifiable answer scored by exact match. Each question ran blind and with the governing clause supplied, which separates failure to recall the current rule from failure to apply it. We tested 28 models between July and October 2026. Blind accuracy ranged from 51.5% to 92.7%, and the highest-scoring models could not be separated. Of 791 failed model-question pairs, 684 (86%) were wrong blind and right with the clause. translated_title: AusClinBench：基于澳大利亚现行临床政策的大语言模型确定性评分基准
translated_abstract: AI模型已经在澳大利亚临床软件中为临床决策提供参考并起草病历记录，而从业者通常不会被告知使用的是哪个模型。现有的医学基准是为其他司法管辖区编写的。我们根据澳大利亚指南和规范编写了142个问题，涵盖五个领域（PBS药品福利计划授权、MBS医疗保险计费、Ahpra执业义务、分诊危险信号、免疫接种与筛查），每个问题都有一个可通过精确匹配进行确定性评分的可验证答案。每个问题均在盲测状态下以及提供相关 governing 条款的情况下分别运行，从而将“无法回忆当前规则”与“无法应用规则”区分开来。我们在2026年7月至10月期间测试了28个模型。盲测准确率介于51.5%至92.7%之间，得分最高的模型之间难以区分优劣。在791个模型-问题失败对中，684个（86%）在盲测时错误，而在提供条款后回答正确。自信错误率介于6.6%至47.8%之间。在五个指南未给出明确方向（原文在此截断）的免疫接种问题上……
tldr: 该研究构建了基于澳大利亚现行临床政策、采用精确匹配确定性评分的142题基准AusClinBench，对28个大语言模型的测试显示盲测准确率为51.5%–92.7%，且86%的错误在提供相关条款后即可纠正，表明模型失败主要源于规则记忆而非规则应用能力。
en_tdlr: This study introduces AusClinBench, a deterministically scored benchmark of 142 questions based on current Australian clinical policy, showing that 28 LLMs achieved 51.5%–92.7% blind accuracy and that 86% of errors were corrected when the governing clause was provided, indicating failures stem mainly from rule recall rather than application.
